title: Need insight
author: prettyetherealburst
selftext:
Hi,

I’ve been dabbling at making a game ( or at least a draft of a game, for now) using claude ai/code and chatgpt.

I’m trying to do an hybrid between a visual novel and a contemplative narrative 2d walking simulator-ish .

So far it’s been really fun ! I like that the Ai really helps with the workflow and put everything so much easier in perspective. Allows for nice creative ideas to come out naturally, I find.

Tho, I feel like using AI in general, especially for things relating to art ( or close to art ) is incredibly frowned upon. Sometimes i’m quite questioning if I should not pursue this path , since it kinda feels like being an impostor.

Do I make sense ? 

Apart from that, i’m also wondering, what do you guys use to help making pixel art / 2d animations / music for your games ? I’m open to tips , insights, anything that could help me explore further my game ideas! 

I wonder if you guys are getting the same criticism about using AI in general too ?

comments.author: affabledrunk
comments.body:
Yes. So much anti-hate everywhere. The thing is is, the anti-ai zealots are gonna shit all over you for any use of AI so you might as well just learn to ignore it and pursue your passion project.

Re:art assets I’m also looking for a better solution than just asking ChatGPT. Especially for generating a consistent set of pixel sprites. It’s challenging. I’m thinking of actually paying somebody to do it but I don’t want to pay thousands….

replies.author: prettyetherealburst
replies.body:
Yeah that’s what i’ve been thinking too 😅
There must be a reliable way out there !
